period_note: COVID-19-affected year. Cumulative-from-Jan-1 convention (for Q1, cumulative equals the discrete first-quarter figure) established from the filing's own column header '01 January to 31 March 2020'. Standalone/Solo basis. Balance sheet was sourced directly from a 350dpi visual render of the source PDF's (1st_quarter_2020.pdf, a scanned/Canon-scanner document with no text layer at all) own Balance Sheet page (source page 7), fully internally consistent (Total Liabilities 237,482,386,915 + Total Shareholders' Equity 20,195,338,081 = Total Assets 257,677,724,996). Income-statement figures were recovered from the FY2021 Q1 filing's (1st_quarter_2021.pdf, a native digital PDF) comparative 'Jan-Mar 2020' column, fully internally consistent (Profit before tax 1,382,802,741 - Provision for tax 593,962,249 = Profit after tax 788,840,491, matching the comparative EPS of 0.83); no 'start-up fund' provision existed yet this quarter (introduced only from Q1 2021). Cross-check: comparative '31 December 2019' balance-sheet column (Total Assets BDT 256,887.04mn, Total Deposits BDT 200,018.31mn, Total Equity BDT 19,367.41mn) matches the existing bank_financials/NCCBANK/quarterly/2019_Q4.json exactly.
